title: 2024 final UK GHG Standard Industrial Classification allocation QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: final

facts.source_fact: The final publication provides UK territorial greenhouse-gas estimates from 1990 to 2024.
facts.expected_handling: Attach territorial accounting basis and series vintage.

facts.source_fact: The final UK greenhouse-gas publication is Accredited Official Statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve official-statistics status as source-quality metadata.

facts.source_fact: Final emissions estimates by source are published in February in the annual release cycle.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish source-basis release timing from later allocation products.

facts.source_fact: Final emissions estimates by end user are added in March in the annual release cycle.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix end-user allocation with source allocation without an explicit mapping.

facts.source_fact: Final emissions estimates by Standard Industrial Classification are added in June in the annual release cycle.
facts.expected_handling: Attach June SIC release vintage to industry allocations.

facts.source_fact: Annex 2 for 2024 final emissions by Standard Industrial Classification was published on 25 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use the latest SIC annex vintage for industry comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 final emissions dataset by Standard Industrial Classification was published on 25 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Carry dataset publication date into derived industry outputs.

facts.source_fact: The SIC product allocates greenhouse-gas emissions using Standard Industrial Classification categories.
facts.expected_handling: Treat SIC as an industry/economic-activity allocation, not a parcel taxonomy.

facts.source_fact: The final statistics cover emissions occurring within the UK territorial boundary.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat the SIC product as a consumption-footprint dataset.

facts.source_fact: On a source basis, carbon dioxide produced by a power station is allocated to the power station.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve source-basis attribution before comparing with end-user values.

facts.source_fact: Under the end-user method, electricity-generation emissions are reallocated to users such as households and industrial consumers.
facts.expected_handling: Require allocation-basis metadata before comparing sector values.

facts.source_fact: DESNZ does not estimate emissions outside the UK associated with UK consumption in the territorial final statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer imported embodied emissions from territorial or SIC totals.

facts.source_fact: Defra publishes separate annual estimates of the UK carbon footprint for consumption-based emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep territorial/SIC and consumption-footprint products distinct.

facts.source_fact: Territorial emissions are grouped into high-level sectors including electricity supply, fuel supply, domestic transport, buildings and product uses, industry, agriculture, waste and LULUCF.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve high-level sector definitions when aggregating detailed rows.

facts.source_fact: More detailed territorial sectors follow IPCC definitions used for international reporting.
facts.expected_handling: Carry classification provenance into crosswalks.

facts.source_fact: The detailed sectors feed international reporting tables submitted annually to the UNFCCC.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently replace international inventory definitions with SIC categories.

facts.source_fact: The 2024 final release provides separate datasets for source, end-user and SIC allocation views.
facts.expected_handling: Require an explicit allocation-basis field on every derived row.

facts.source_fact: The National Data Library entry identifies the dataset under the Open Government Licence.
facts.expected_handling: Carry licence and source attribution metadata into redistributed outputs.

facts.source_fact: The National Data Library entry for final UK greenhouse-gas emissions was updated on 25 June 2026 with the 2024 SIC resources.
facts.expected_handling: Use metadata freshness checks before assuming the latest SIC vintage.

facts.source_fact: The SIC dataset is an industry-classification allocation of national territorial emissions rather than a parcel-level measurement source.
facts.expected_handling: Block parcel-value inference unless a separate parcel-binding source exists.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited allocation fact without broadening its scope.
Attach territorial, source/end-user/SIC and sector boundary before downstream use.
Attach February/March/June release stage and 2026 publication date.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents stale or incomplete allocation products being mixed.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry DESNZ publication, dataset and classification provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert SIC industry allocations into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
